Class Ability usage applies Misdirection to enemies within <pve 10 /> <pvp [22] /> meters.

//Definitely bugged but lord knows if/when they'll fix this bug since it's such an underused exotic

Misdirection:
• Deals ~0 damage but counts as a Hit
• PVE: Disorients <link Minors and Elites [#CombatantClassifications] /> for 5 seconds<pve/>
• PVP: briefly distorts audio, Disorients, and disables Radar for 5 seconds<pvp/>
